user.title: New recording profile
user.description: A profile decides which cameras record into which folder. You can pick any camera that is already set up in Home Assistant, and use the same camera in several profiles. A camera never records in two profiles at the same time though, the first profile to start keeps it. An empty field takes the default (currently: target folder {default_folder}, pattern {default_pattern}). In the file name pattern you can use the placeholders cam (camera), short (short code) and profile (profile), each in curly braces, plus date and time with %CCYY %MM %DD %hh %mm %ss.

data.name: Name (e.g. Stairs)
data.folder: Target folder (empty = default; pick one or type your own, subfolders like Security/Stairs work too)

user_when.title: When to record?
user_when.description: Without triggers and without a restriction (time window, weekdays, sun) the profile only starts by hand. With a restriction but no trigger it records continuously during that time. With triggers it records as long as one is "on" and the restriction fits. An empty field takes the default (currently: run-on {default_after}, maximum length {default_max}, time window {default_window}, weekdays {default_weekdays}, sun {default_sun}). To override: from = until means all day, all seven weekdays means every day, "any time" for sun.

data.max_minutes: Maximum length per recording (0 = unlimited, empty = default)

init.title: Defaults: how to record
init.description: These values apply to every profile that does not fill the field itself. When a profile changes a value, that only overrides it for this profile and the default stays unchanged. An empty field means not set.

data.folder: Default target folder (pick one or type your own)
data.max_minutes: Default maximum length per recording (0 = unlimited)

when.title: Defaults: when to record
when.description: Careful: a profile without its own trigger records on its own as soon as a time window, weekdays or sun apply here and the profile does not override them. To override in the profile, set "from" and "until" to the same time (all day), pick all seven weekdays, or choose "any time" for sun.
